roles.title: Under Secretary for Research and Engineering
Under Secretary of War for Research and Engineering and Department of War Chief Technology Officer

summary.text: In a 2025 official-role transcript, Emil Michael said local rules should not slow companies, and official-role posts called for an “AI-first” Department of War and prioritizing speed over bureaucracy. He described a goal of AI capabilities on every Department of War desktop and said AI is being embedded into systems to improve warfighter precision, speed, and decision-making. Official-role posts described finalized agreements with eight AI model and infrastructure companies and a Department rollout intended to expand AI use. In 2026 official-role posts, he said Anthropic remained a designated supply-chain risk and that its products were being removed from the Department, calling it hostile to the warfighter.
